CMDP view (cost = violating steps): analytical E[N] ≈ 0.000  |  sample mean 0.000 ± 0.000  |  budget d = 1.0  PASSES (analytical formula, evaluated numerically)
Chance view: P(any violation in the episode) ≈ 0.000 ± 0.000 (estimate)  |  level δ = 0.05  SAMPLE PASSES
Risk view: VaRα(Z) = -0.200, CVaRα(Z) = -0.200 (mean of the worst 10% of the 200 sampled excursions; must be ≤ 0)  SAMPLE PASSES
Hard view: worst sampled excursion max Z = -0.200 (must be ≤ 0 in every episode)  SAMPLE PASSES — with σ = 0 this checks exactly the trajectory from x = 0 through the selected horizon, not invariance of the whole safe set.
Analytic: stationary sd σ∞ = σ/√(k(2−k)) = 0.0000, stationary per-step violation probability p∞ = 1 − Φ((1 − 0.8)/σ∞) = 0.0000; Markov bound on the chance view: P ≤ E[N] = 0.000.
